run_test_build_backbones: run the unittest that builds all registered backbones and verifies forward pass output shapes
test_backbone_registry: test that the backbone registry contains registered backbone builders and each one constructs correctly
test_backbone_out_channels: test that each backbone has an out_channels attribute matching its output tensor shape
review_test_backbones_class: review the TestBackbones unittest class and its test_build_backbones method for backbone validation logic
refactor_backbone_cfgs: refactor the BACKBONE_CFGS mapping to add or update config file paths for backbone variants
